dedupe_keys.name: commodity flow survey expanded hazardous materials cfs ehm estimates

description: The Commodity Flow Survey Expanded Hazardous Materials Supplement (CFS-EHM) is sponsored by the Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA) and conducted by the U.S. Census Bureau as an experimental product. It estimates the total number of establishments that ship hazardous materials (hazmat), the types of hazmat shipped and the packaging used. It was collected as a supplement to the first and fourth quarters of the 2022 Commodity Flow Survey, whose sample is 165,000 establishments: respondents that shipped hazmat in 2021 or 2022 named their ten most frequent hazmat types and gave packaging, quantity and transport mode for the top three. Coverage: national and Petroleum Administration for Defense District (PADD) level estimates in 11 tables for each of the survey years 2021 and 2022. Format and access: two XLSX release files, a methodology report and a flyer on the Census Bureau's www2 server; free and public domain. Caveats: experimental, coarse geography (five PADDs), and establishment counts, not shipment flows; PHMSA uses it to judge the impact of changes to hazmat shipping rules. Simulation uses: characterising the hazmat shipper population and packaging by region for risk models of hazardous materials transport by road, rail, water and pipeline, and for emergency response planning along freight corridors. Related records: the Commodity Flow Survey (whose hazardous materials series gives hazmat flows), CFS Subarea Estimates, the Freight Analysis Framework and PHMSA incident data.
